body:
Some basic background: I am an avid Cannabis consumer, and generally vape Cannabis 4-5 times a week. I have never tried any other drugs prior to this experience. I did not consume any other drugs on LSD.
I wanted to learn something about myself, and the world while on LSD. I had a friend, we shall call him Friend A, who had consumed LSD at least 6 times and had reported that while it was a very powerful substance, that it had the power to reveal things to you about yourself, spirituality, God, and the nature of life. This of course interested me, as I have a deep desire to explore my own mind, and experience the universe. So naturally when I came across some, I knew I had to try it as I was unlikely to ever come across any again for a very long time.
At T+0:00 I consumed one tab, which had no taste, and was 0.25x0.25 inches square, dosed at '125ug' however, it was probably more like 100ug knowing how these things get 'up-selled' often.
At T+0:30 I was feeling tension in my jaw, lots of energy, and started feeling really good. I was starting to feel a warm sensation through out my entire body, like an electric vibration that just felt so good.
At T+0:45 I started to see bright colors everywhere. Things started looking 'zoomed out' and then 'zoomed in' if I wanted to focus on it. I could control it somewhat, I called it 'perspective shifts' in my notes.
At T+1:00 I was starting to see swirling motions. I was laughing randomly, smiling the entire time. Everything felt extremely euphoric. Light swirling motions on flat objects, colors very enhanced. Felt really good overall, huge mood lift. Laughing at random stupid things. Thoughts were sped up immensely. I was restless and couldn't stop moving around. Very energetic.
At T+1:30 a friend joined me, this one we shall call Friend K. He took 1 tab, and I took another. I now have taken 2 tabs total for a total of 250ug. I expected this tab to do nothing more than extend my trip. How very wrong I was!
At T+2:30 I was laughing non stop, extremely euphoric, colors were shifting and I was living in a rainbow. Things were very warped, I could see huge amounts of detail on anything I looked at. Things were very fluid, moving and morphing. The walls were melting, my hair on my arm was twisting and turning while changing colors. It was dancing in this most beautiful way, synchronized to the music.
At T+3:00 me and Friend K noticed that lights had emotions and projects entirely new feels, emotions, and atmospheres into the room. A purple light felt extremely euphoric and warm, while a blue light felt very liberating and cool. We could feel the light on our skin, and was the weirdest yet most amazing sensation I had ever experienced.
At T+4:00 me and Friend K decided to walk to the local gas station (it was 10:00pm at night) and get a drink as we were both parched. As soon as we opened the door, the synthesia for both of us was huge! Everything was dancing around, colors were taking over everything. The lights passed through the colors of the rainbow rapidly, going from red to blue to green to yellow within 5 seconds and repeating over and over again. The ambient music caused everything to grow and shrink and bump to the beat. It was absolutely awe inspiring.
The lights passed through the colors of the rainbow rapidly, going from red to blue to green to yellow within 5 seconds and repeating over and over again. The ambient music caused everything to grow and shrink and bump to the beat. It was absolutely awe inspiring.
We were the only two in there so we got our stuff and got out fast. We weren't in there for more than 5 minutes but it felt like 30 minutes. The concept of time was so warped we knew we fucked up by going in there. We were both way too high to be out in public, yet we felt incredible joy and euphoria to see the amazing colors on everything.
At T+5:00 we discovered that food tasted like cardboard. It took us a solid hour to decide to try the food we got at the gas station, I was peaking extremely high, and I could project my consciousness onto objects. Thought loops were so severe and reality shattering at this point that I could no longer talk for more than a few seconds before I entered into an entirely new universe of thought. I was able to effectively live memories over and over again, analyze problems and watch them play out. I would often snap back into reality (well, back into lucidity as I was still seeing rainbows and colors on everything) long enough to tell Friend K where I had just traveled (about 30 seconds) before traveling back into space.
At this point I don't remember much about time or what happened outside my mind for the next 2-3 hours. I was deep into my own universe. I was able to live as objects briefly, and feel their lives for a few minutes before warping back into myself and jumping into another loop. This was extremely pleasant yet mind boggling. I was not sure where I was, who I was, or what was happening. There were colors and lights and details I could never explain in words. There was such awe inspiring emotions, yet it felt like emotions were abstract thought concepts. The floor felt alive and even though I was face down on carpet, it was like living in a jungle of music. Music controlled every aspect of my senses.
I felt like I could live entire lives inside my 'moments' and could experience life as many copies of myself, each within it's own parallel concept of time.
At T+11:00 I was fully down, and headed to bed. I slept okay, was restless a bit, and woke up the next day feeling refreshed, yet still in awe of what happened.
